text: Landed in the tool, not in begin-session: seat_commit.py commits a self-registration as HEAD's contracts/seats.json with the seat's one entry added, through an index of its own, so that other seats' entries written into the working file at the same time neither block it nor come along; the pre-commit hook judges that index as any commit's, and the real index is set to the commit, so the others' entries stay unstaged for their own commits. When the working file then holds what HEAD holds in another order, it is written as HEAD's text. Test: test_seats_seated_at_the_same_time_each_commit_their_own_entry (a meta seat and a design seat seated before either commits; each commits its own; check 6 passes the history), watched failing on HEAD's tool first. bootstrap.py seat and machine now write contracts/seats.json with LF, which git had warned of on this computer. No session needs to wait or remove its entry by hand any more.
